rows.SMC.label: State Machine Coverable
rows.SMC.desc: The net can be covered by State Machine components.
rows.SMD.label: State Machine Decomposable
rows.SMD.desc: The net can be covered by strongly connected State Machine components.
rows.SMA.label: State Machine Allocatable
rows.SMA.desc: Every selection of pre-places selects an SZZM component.
rows.B.label: Bounded
rows.B.desc: The number of tokens in any place stays below a certain limit.
rows.DSt.label: Reachable Deadlock State
rows.DSt.desc: There is a marking reachable from M0 in which no transition is enabled.
rows.DTr.label: Dead Transitions at M0
rows.DTr.desc: There is a transition that is never enabled in any marking reachable from M0.
rows.DTr2.label: Dead Transitions at M0
rows.DTr2.desc: Every transition is enabled in some marking reachable from M0.
rows.DTr3.label: Dead Transitions at M0
rows.DTr3.desc: DTr could not be determined without an exact state space.
rows.REV.label: Reversible
rows.REV.desc: The initial marking is reachable from every other reachable marking.
rows.L.label: Live
rows.L.desc: All transitions are L4: from every reachable marking, each transition can become enabled again.
rows.Lp.label: Live Places
rows.Lp.desc: For each place with a post-set, every reachable marking can reach a marking enabling an output transition of the place (Starke, Def. 14.5).
rows.LS.label: Live and Safe
rows.LS.desc: The net is live and every place holds at most one token in all reachable markings.
rows.DCF.label: Dynamic Conflict Free
rows.DCF.desc: No transition is in conflict during execution.
rows.BSt.label: Bad States
rows.BSt.desc: Reachable states that violate the bad states defined in the editor below.
rows.PER.label: Persistent
rows.PER.desc: Firing a transition never disables another enabled transition.
rows.BSt2.label: Bad States
rows.BSt2.desc: Default result for unsafe markings (any place with more than one token). Specific formulas can be checked through the Bad States API.
rows.ORD.label: Ordinary
rows.ORD.desc: All arc weights are equal to 1.
rows.HOM.label: Homogeneous
rows.HOM.desc: All output arcs of a place have the same weight.
rows.CON.label: Connected
rows.CON.desc: The net is a single component (no isolated nodes).
rows.SC.label: Strongly Connected
rows.SC.desc: There is a directed path between any two nodes.
rows.PUR.label: Pure
rows.SCF.label: Static Conflict Free
rows.SCF.desc: Each place has at most one transition in its post-set.
rows.SCON.label: Structural Concurrency
rows.SCON.desc: Distinct transitions do not share input places.
rows.MG.label: Marked Graph
rows.MG.desc: Each place has exactly one input and one output.
rows.FC.label: Free Choice
rows.FC.desc: If two transitions share an input, it is their only input.
rows.EFC.label: Extended Free Choice
rows.EFC.desc: Transitions that share an input have identical input sets.
rows.NBM.label: Non-Blocking Multiplication
rows.NBM.desc: The minimum consumption multiplicity is not smaller than the production one.
rows.SM.label: State Machine
rows.SM.desc: Each transition has exactly one input and one output.
rows.ES.label: Extended Simple
rows.ES.desc: Place post-sets are either disjoint or nested.
rows.Ft0.label: Transitions without Pre-set
rows.Ft0.desc: No transition has an empty set of input places.
rows.tF0.label: Transitions without Post-set
rows.tF0.desc: No transition has an empty set of output places.
rows.Fp0.label: Places without Pre-set
rows.Fp0.desc: No place has an empty set of input transitions.
rows.pF0.label: Places without Post-set
rows.pF0.desc: No place has an empty set of output transitions.
rows.GFC.label: Globally Free Choice
rows.GFC.desc: Transitions that share an input are jointly enabled in every reachable state.
rows.SB.label: Structurally Bounded
rows.SB.desc: The net is bounded for any initial marking.
rows.CSV.label: Conservative
rows.CSV.desc: The weighted sum of tokens stays constant.
rows.CPI.label: P-Invariant Coverage
rows.CPI.desc: The net is covered by positive P-invariants.
rows.CTI.label: T-Invariant Coverage
rows.CTI.desc: The net is covered by positive T-invariants.
rows.PInv.label: P-Invariant Count
rows.TInv.label: T-Invariant Count
deadlockTrap.desc: Every reachable deadlock contains a marked trap.
pendingRequired: Required properties are being completed in the background; the rest are available on demand.
pendingBLS: Calculating B, L and L&S in the background…
pendingCSVSB: Calculating CSV and SB in the background…

behavior.done: Computed on the complete reachability graph.

scc.desc: Maximal sets of states that can all reach one another.
scc.terminalDesc: Components with no way out: where the system ends up.
scc.homeDesc: States reachable from every state. They exist when there is exactly one terminal component.
